; Isekai Hero - translation template
;
; Copy this to <code>.txt (de.txt, zh.txt, pl.txt ...), put it in
; Data\SKSE\Plugins\IsekaiHero\lang\, and set Language in IsekaiHero.ini.
;
; Translate the RIGHT side of each = only. Rules:
;   - \n is a line break. Keep them: panel layouts are measured, not wrapped.
;   - {} is a value the mod fills in. Keep every one, in any order you need.
;   - Lines starting with ; are comments. UTF-8, no BOM needed.
;   - A key you delete or leave empty simply stays English. A partial
;     translation is a working translation.
;
; GENERATED by tools/extract-strings.mjs - re-run it after the mod updates to see
; which keys are new.
